title: Matrix Representations of Finite Fields
summary: Finite fields are important algebraic structures that have a wide range of applications in fields such as coding theory and cryptography. But the standard construction of finite field extensions through polynomial quotients is computationally opaque, especially when we want to identify a degree-$2$ extension of $F_8$ and a degree-$3$ extension of $F_4$. In this short note, we present a coherent family of representations by matrices $ρ_q^n\colon F_{q^n} \to F_q^{n\times n}$ for all prime powers $q$ and all degrees $n \ge 1$.
